seo_desc: BAT Pro 12mm square notch trowel for spreading tile adhesive on floors and large format tiles. Professional trade trowel. Shop tiling tools at ETS Perth.
aka: notched trowel, tiling trowel, tile adhesive trowel
descriptionHtml:
The BAT Pro 12 mm Square Notch Trowel lays the thick, even adhesive bed that large format floor and wall tiles need. Square notches comb full ribs that collapse evenly under the tile, pushing air out and lifting adhesive coverage, which is where most bond failures start.

Use it for

  • Large format porcelain and stone on floors and walls
  • Uneven substrates that need more adhesive depth
  • Back buttering heavy tiles

Features

  • 12 mm square notch
  • Soft grip handle for long stretches of combing
  • Part of the BAT Pro trowel range, which runs from 4 mm to 15 mm notches

Specifications

  • Notch: 12 mm square
  • Handle: soft grip

Good to know

  • Match the notch to the adhesive data sheet and tile size; 12 mm is a common call for tiles 600 mm and larger
  • Comb in one direction and lay the tile across the ribs so air can escape
  • Wash the blade before adhesive sets so the notches stay true

Also known as: notched trowel, tiling trowel, tile adhesive trowel.

seo_desc: Size: 600ml sausage Movement Capability: +/-25% Tack-free Time: <60mins Features: Isocyanate free, Smooth finish
aka: paintable sealant
descriptionHtml:
Roberts Designs Trade Grade Hybrid Sealant is a hybrid polyurethane sealant in a 600ml sausage for movement, expansion and perimeter joints, inside or out. It stretches and recovers through plus or minus 25 percent joint movement, can be painted once cured, and contains no isocyanates or solvents.

Use it for

  • Expansion and movement joints in tiled floors, balconies and facades
  • Perimeter joints between tile and walls, frames or skirting
  • Sealing to concrete, fibre cement, brick, stone, metals and PVC

Features

  • Isocyanate and solvent free
  • Highly elastic: plus or minus 25 percent dynamic joint movement
  • Paintable once cured
  • UV resistant and weatherproof
  • Non-slumping, non-bubbling, smooth finish
  • Meets ASTM C719

Specifications

  • Size: 600ml sausage
  • Technology: Hybrid polyurethane, moisture curing
  • Tack-free time: under 60 minutes
  • Shore A hardness: 30 to 40
  • Application temperature: 5 to 50 degrees C
  • Colours: White, Beige, Black, Concrete Grey, Bronze, Epping Grey, Off White, Light Brown, Redwood or Sandstone
  • Model: RDH100W (White)

Good to know

  • Surfaces must be clean and dry. Use a backer rod so the sealant depth is about half the joint width, gun it in and tool it within 10 minutes.
  • Needs a 600ml sausage gun such as the Roberts Designs Sausage Caulking Gun (RDXA3007).

Also known as: paintable sealant.
